candidate.rationale: cs=120 predicts max positive pressure demand within 3.5% density change; rho_0=0 keeps pair background pressure positive as in native tests, whose mechanical effect is measured. dt=1e-6 is below acoustic/viscous estimates and is still subject to probe and half-step checks.

diagnostic_plan.unique_main_change: Unforced dt is halved; same native model, units, Uniform constructor, mass, N, velocity seed and physical sample interval.
diagnostic_plan.measured_cost_source: sdpd_half_dt total charged wall / actual steps
diagnostic_plan.purpose: Compare early unforced target-liquid heating/relaxation at dt and dt/2; also audit saved pre-kick and post-kick velocity channels. This is a transient diagnostic, not a qualification run.
diagnostic_plan.interpretation_rule: A similar large peak and decay supports initialization-driven heating over a dominant time-step cause of that transient; late equilibrium bias remains unverified. One different-dt random path is not an independent repeated estimate.
diagnostic_plan.initial_state_rule: Same pinned library, Uniform particle name/rank/domain/density and Python velocity seed as the old equilibrium task; save new actual initial state. Old t=0 positions were not saved, so direct cross-run initial hashes are unavailable.
diagnostic_plan.stop_conditions: Original shared-budget watchdog, nonfinite state, invalid particle count, or completed fixed steps. Partial results never imply completed discrimination.
diagnostic_plan.why_still_informative: It spans the observed heating peak and substantial decay, so it tests transient time-step dependence without repeating an inadequate qualification attempt.
